summary: Primarily a catch-up episode after a hiatus. Duck discusses moving to New Zealand with his family for lifestyle reasons. Cred mentions selling Breakout (his trading platform) to Kraken. Brief market discussion notes S&P 500 outperforming BTC. Episode focused on life philosophy about making money in crypto slowly over multiple cycles rather than quick memecoin gains, and the importance of actually keeping your gains.
key_takeaways: Duck moved to New Zealand - surfing, family, quality of life
Cred's Breakout platform acquired by Kraken
S&P 500 outperforming BTC in this period
Making money slowly over multiple cycles leads to keeping it, unlike quick memecoin gains
Most people who get rich quickly don't keep the money
